local function qr(s, a, b, c, d)
s[a] = u32(s[a] + s[b]); s[d] = lrot(bxor(s[d], s[a]), 16)
s[c] = u32(s[c] + s[d]); s[b] = lrot(bxor(s[b], s[c]), 12)

end

local function _z11_ab47fd7(key, counter, nonce)
local s = {
bit32.bxor(0x2d387f2e, 0x4c48074b), bit32.bxor(0x46fab771, 0x75dad31f), bit32.bxor(0x6c5eb6eb, 0x153c9bd9), bit32.bxor(0xe5918f50, 0x8eb1ea24),
